ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring pipeline that tracks industrial land and water discharge changes in real time for compliance verification.
ideas.title: NeuraCompliance: Satellite Monitoring for Industrial Environmental Regulation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven high-scoring pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying computer vision to satellite imagery for industrial oversight, which directly aligns with judges looking for real-world relevance and high technical execution.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered risk detection platform combining graph intelligence and LightGBM to identify suspicious trade flows and supply chain compliance risks.
ideas.title: BioRiskAML: Supply Chain AML & Risk Detection Graph Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the architecture of Bito to a generalized supply chain threat detection model, offering judges a production-grade backend with explainable AI components.

ideas.pitch: A quantitative forecasting dashboard utilizing Poisson GAM and multinomial share models to predict and backtest AI safety and operational incidents.
ideas.title: AegisForecast: Automated AI Incident Forecaster with Calibrated Intervals
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates the rigorous statistical methodology of the Apart Research winning project, impressing technical judges with robust uncertainty quantification and rolling backtests.

ideas.pitch: An AI agent system tailored for specialized clinics to automate patient intake, trust-building consultation summaries, and scheduling.
ideas.title: TrustPatient: AI-Powered Patient Acquisition and Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the rapid-execution blueprint of Global-Smile, focusing on a hyper-specific vertical market need that allows for an immediately demoable and practical user journey.

ideas.pitch: A video analytics platform that ingests unstructured training or operational footage and converts it into a deeply searchable, queryable vector database.
ideas.title: VideoLibrAI: Unstructured Video Intelligence and Semantic Indexing
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors LibrAI's winning formula by transforming chaotic unstructured data into a slick, highly functional interface with instant visual utility for enterprise workflows.
